subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: After the streamed-response defect is fixed, should Copilot BYOK enforce the proposed hard 16 MiB body limit and 30-second body-read timeout for every supported provider request?
rationale: Current releases impose no such envelope, and neither the Copilot SDK contract nor CI can decide the acceptable compatibility boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Keep 16 MiB / 30 seconds
options.body: Retain the proposed limits after deterministic 413/408 handling and focused compatibility proof are added.

options.title: Increase the envelope
options.body: Select larger fixed limits if realistic supported BYOK payloads or upload conditions can exceed the proposal.

options.title: Pause the hard limit
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define another compatibility policy or an appropriate SDK seam.

recommendation.title: Keep 16 MiB / 30 seconds
recommendation.body: Retain the proposed limits after deterministic 413/408 handling and focused compatibility proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the BYOK provider parity feature and are the strongest feature-history owner for its request envelope.
